title: Enhance orientation tracking, add telemetry support, and simplify settings

Added: New Mahony orientation filter, offered as an alternative to the existing Madgwick filter
Orientation calibration can now be triggered and configured directly over BLE
Telemetry can be switched between a lightweight step-counter-only mode and full sensor streaming
Changed: Reworked calibration internals behind a single, swappable orientation-filter wrapper
Cleaned up unused BLE configuration left over from earlier releases
The release process now validates the version number and checks the changelog before a release is tagged

title: Enhance map, navigation, and settings features for a better user experience

Added: Satellite imagery toggle on the map
Orientation-filter algorithm is now configurable from the app
Device names are now cached, speeding up the scan screen
Changed: General map screen and OpenStreetMap integration improvements
Cleaned up the orientation-filter settings and removed unused options
Improved how trail recording tracks state and step count

title: Enhance location search, device naming, and camera functionality

Added: Location search on the map, from a new toolbar button
Changed: The app now consistently shows a device's saved name instead of its raw Bluetooth name
Updated the app icon and added map-matching for smoother on-map positioning
The map now centers on your GPS location once on launch, and stays put afterward instead of re-centering every time you revisit the Map tab or Settings

title: Improved app security, added navigation, and streamlined upload process

Changed: Tightened BLE security and pairing behavior
Added a navigation service on the device and stopped accepting building floor-plan uploads over BLE — indoor mapping now lives entirely in the phone app

title: Enhanced map features, improved navigation, and refactored codebase

Added: More reliable fetching and rendering of indoor building outlines from OpenStreetMap
Recorded navigation sessions can now be replayed from a CSV file
Changed: Smoother camera movement and building-highlight rendering on the map
Faster, per-tile building-data caching with proper cancellation of stale requests
Clearer status messages while the map loads data
Fixed: Fixed inconsistent building-data caching that could show stale results
Fixed the camera position and edit-mode preview not restoring correctly

title: Enhance sensor accuracy, simplify controls, and improve BLE performance

Added: Local gravity reference is now configurable over BLE and used by the step detector for more accurate step counting
New magnetometer capture mode dedicated to calibration, with smoother handling throughout the flow
Accelerometer calibration support, with refined timing
Changed: Improved motion-detection thresholds and automatic zeroing for steadier readings when the device is at rest
Simplified and streamlined the internal BLE connection handling
Introduced the Madgwick orientation filter (later joined by Mahony in 1.0.7)

title: Enhanced safety with reset confirmation dialog

Changed: Resetting calibration now asks for confirmation first, to prevent accidental resets

title: Enhanced navigation, improved calibration, and updated UI features

Added: Live 3D route visualization while navigating, with drag-to-rotate and pinch-to-zoom
Auto-connect: the app now remembers and automatically reconnects to your last device on launch, with pull-to-refresh on the scan screen
All-new 6-position accelerometer calibration — lay the device on each of its six faces, in any order; automatic face detection removes a small factory offset that was tilting the gravity reference
Calibration now tracks how much of the "coverage sphere" you've rotated through and ends automatically once it's covered enough, replacing the old fixed-timer approach
New calibration quality checks reject bad results before they reach the device, with a "Fit quality" panel showing any warnings
Visual guidance during calibration: on-screen markers show which directions still need coverage, plus a depth cue for the live sensor reading
Renamed the "Orientation" tab to "Visualization" and merged it with a new Navigation section
GPS logging, for easier field debugging
Changed: Alignment calibration now iterates to convergence and automatically discards noisy samples, meaningfully improving accuracy and repeatability
Calibration results are now verified by reading them back from the device before confirming success, instead of trusting the write blindly
Magnetometer data sent over Bluetooth was rescaled for ~10x finer precision — **requires updating the app and firmware together**
Migrated the map from flutter_map to MapLibre for smoother rendering and building overlays
General Bluetooth connection, firmware-version comparison, and data-handling improvements
Removed: Editable calibration-duration setting — superseded by automatic coverage-based completion
Fixed: Fixed a magnetometer calibration bug where the computed heading correction was inverted, doubling the actual heading error
Fixed a related math bug that could, in rare cases, save invalid calibration data to the device
"Clear route" in navigation no longer needs a second tap and no longer draws a stray line
Fixed several smaller display bugs: the live calibration dot, position/CSV units, and a Bluetooth race condition when clearing a route

title: OTA image-versioning fix

Fixed: Fixed OTA updates occasionally failing their final verification step: every released image now carries a real, distinct version number instead of a placeholder, so the device can always tell a new image apart from the one already running
Changed: The release process now bakes the chosen version straight into the firmware image before building, so every release is uniquely identifiable
Added: Releases can now include an optional build-number suffix, making it possible to re-publish the same version with a fresh, testable image without bumping the version number

title: Calibration and position fixes

Added: Raw, uncalibrated magnetometer readings are now always available over BLE — useful for diagnostics and calibration tooling
Changed: Reorganized the BLE telemetry layout for clarity, with expanded documentation in the README
Dead-reckoning position is now reported as fine-grained, continuously accumulated distance instead of coarse integer steps
Step detection now buffers internally so every detected step is guaranteed to be reported exactly once, even under bursty BLE traffic
Fixed: Improved reported position precision over BLE, down to 1 mm resolution

title: Mag calibration improvements

Added: New magnetometer calibration data can now be pushed to the device over BLE and takes effect immediately, with no restart required
Changed: Reorganized how calibration is loaded internally so the device reliably picks up new calibration data as soon as it's written

title: Implemented fetching NOAA (World Magnetic Model) declination and magnetic field

Added: The app now fetches your local declination and magnetic field strength from the NOAA World Magnetic Model, shown in a new info widget
Changed: Calibration now uses this real-world geomagnetic reference for improved accuracy
Fixed: Various minor bug fixes and improvements

title: Changed map to 3D only MapLibre and calibration improvements

Added: 3D buildings now render on the map, extruded from real OpenStreetMap footprints
Changed: Migrated the map engine to MapLibre for better 3D rendering and overlay support
The release script can now overwrite an existing version tag when needed
Fixed: The calibration scatter plot now always starts empty when you open the Calibration tab, instead of showing leftover points from a previous session
Typed calibration/route/floor-height values are now saved when you tap away, not only on keyboard submit
Fixed a crash when leaving the Map tab, caused by the map controller being disposed twice

title: Write-only mag calibration data, OTA security level fix

Added: The status LED now reflects OTA update progress in real time
Changed: Briefly raised the security level required for firmware updates, then reverted it — this device pairs without a screen or PIN, and the higher level would have locked updates out entirely
Firmware-update permissions now correctly match the device's actual pairing security level

title: Calibration UI and versioned builds

Added: New calibration settings screen with a live magnetometer monitor
Changed: More accurate two-pass alignment calibration algorithm
Improved the ellipsoid and hard-iron calibration math
Fixed: Fixed OTA firmware updates hanging or timing out: improved the update protocol's data handling, added retries, and reordered the update steps for reliability
Fixed the OTA screen layout and calibration marker position
Fixed the firmware-update manifest pointing to the wrong URL

title: OTA website uri fix

Added: New calibration cards UI with a live 3D scatter plot, auto-countdown, and the ability to delete a capture and retry
App version is now derived automatically from the release git tag
Changed: Improved the ellipsoid and hard-iron calibration algorithms
Cleaned up Bluetooth connection handling
Fixed: Fixed raw magnetometer display and the 3D wireframe orientation view
Fixed the OTA screen layout and calibration marker position

title: OTA firmware updates and full magnetometer calibration

Added: Wireless firmware updates over BLE, using the industry-standard MCUmgr protocol — no cable required to update the device
A full 3-matrix magnetometer calibration pipeline, replacing the earlier simple offset correction, with calibrated readings now exposed live in telemetry
An interactive release script and a version number derived straight from the git tag, so every build is traceable
Migrated the build to a sysbuild project (bootloader and application are now built and signed together)
Changed: Improved gyroscope bias estimation right after power-on, for more accurate readings from a cold start
Improved sensor math and BLE service handling throughout the telemetry pipeline
Added step-length calibration over BLE
Power-saving mode is now on by default and configurable at runtime
Renamed "building height" to "floor count" for clarity
Added LE Secure Connections and a standard Bluetooth Device Information Service
Fixed: Extended the hard-iron magnetometer calibration duration for a more reliable fit
Improved reported position precision (down to 1 mm) and widened its data range
Fixed a Bluetooth device-filtering configuration bug

title: Calibration fixes and OTA update

Added: Wireless (OTA) firmware updates, straight from the app
3D ball-and-stick visualization of device orientation
Redesigned navigation: building outlines, start/stop control, and loop-closure detection
Indoor step-based navigation using OpenStreetMap building data
Power-save mode, enabled by default
Windows desktop support
Changed: Simplified and hardened Bluetooth connection handling on Linux, with a watchdog that reconnects automatically if telemetry stalls
Fixed: Fixed various Bluetooth connection and map/navigation rendering issues

title: Initial release: calibration, orientation, and map visualization

Added: First release: full 3-matrix magnetometer calibration, live 3D orientation visualization, and map integration with OpenStreetMap
Changed: Dependency and build-system updates

title: Navigation foundations: calibration and dead-reckoning

Added: IMU calibration and dead-reckoning position tracking — the foundation of the device's step-based navigation
BLE controller and sensor telemetry services stood up for the first time
A configurable limit on how many phones can be paired to the device at once
Documented the BLE data layout in the README
Changed: Reduced magnetometer calibration time
Simplified battery-charger logic and LED brightness handling; battery voltage is now monitored directly
Simplified beacon and power-manager start-up
Fixed: Fixed a Bluetooth privacy setting so the device is correctly recognized on reconnect
Fixed an internal pairing-state bug that could misreport pairing failures

title: BLE services and first magnetometer calibration

Added: Core BLE services stood up: device configuration, telemetry, and step count, plus a standard Battery Service and Bluetooth bonding support
First working magnetometer calibration
Dead-reckoning position now included in the telemetry stream
Changed: Widened the position data range in telemetry
Cleaned up outdated documentation
Fixed: Fixed a Bluetooth device-filtering bug and five other correctness issues found in code review
Fixed an internal pairing-state bug

title: Wake-on-motion sensor bring-up

Added: New motion-sensor driver with wake-on-motion support, letting the device sleep until it's actually moved
Refined LED animations, battery-charger state handling, and heartbeat timing
Fixed: Tuned the new motion sensor's wake-on-motion detection settings

title: nRF Connect SDK bring-up

Added: Full nRF Connect SDK project configuration: build tasks, debugger/RTT terminal integration, erase-and-flash task
BLE stack enabled together with IMU data handling
Battery charger state-machine logic
LED driver with PWM support, including PWM control for the red status LED
Unit tests for the `Vector` and `Quaternion` math classes (Google Test)
Changed: Application layer refactored into modules (`src/app/...`) — the structure the codebase still uses today
Barometer pressure reading corrected from kPa to hPa
ADC settings refactored for improved battery-voltage measurement accuracy
Device version bumped to 2.4.0 for reproducible flash/recovery behavior
Removed: Unused sensor and performance-timer code left over from the STM32 prototype

prose: Direct lead-in to `v0.1.0`: first commit after ~1 year of repository inactivity

title: Platform migration: STM32 → nRF52840 (Zephyr / NCS)

Changed: **Platform migration**: the STM32WB55 codebase was retired and the project restarted on **nRF52840** using **Zephyr / nRF Connect SDK** — the architecture the product still uses
Board bring-up re-implemented on the new platform: GPIO, LED, and button drivers as Zephyr-style classes
SPI sensor drivers re-implemented using Zephyr devicetree (DTS) bindings instead of hand-rolled STM32 HAL code
Logging switched to the Zephyr logging API; Segger RTT console enabled for on-target debug output, replacing the STM32-era USB/UART logging
Added: Google Test unit-testing submodule integrated for host-side testing
Standard (non-minimal) build configuration profile
Fixed: LED now blinks 3 times on an init error, as a hardware-level fault indicator

prose: Spans 2024-12-13 to 2025-05-17. No commits exist between 2023-11-14 (`v0.0.3`)

title: STM32WB55 mainboard hardware maturation

Added: Barometer (ICP10125) driver template, plus device-address and reading-error fixes
CRC-8 MAXIM implementation with unit tests; test tree moved to its own directory
USB DFU (firmware update over USB) implemented (FS-mode DFU, `USBD_FS`)
SWO/ITM hardware debugging support; UART removed in favor of it
ADC class with DMA support, HAL timeout tuning, and dedicated error handling
Changed: Switched target MCU to the STM32WB55VGY variant; updated linker for the extended wireless stack
I2C driver changed to explicit MasterTX/MasterRX transfers
Logging interface refactored from SCI to RSCI
Fixed: SPI implementation issues surfaced after integrating it with the rest of the firmware
DMA receive corruption on I2C; unused DMA channels removed

prose: Spans 2023-09-07 to 2023-11-14, on the "mainboard" PCB revision. No commits

title: BLE beacon + AHRS filter

Added: BLE beacon implementation (`beacon.cpp`) — iterated from AltBeacon, to an ST proprietary format, and finally to iBeacon with legacy + extended advertising
Madgwick AHRS orientation filter — first quaternion/Euler-angle implementation with sensor-fusion timing
Task runner utility
Barometer: initial documentation and error handling
USB peripheral bring-up (groundwork for the DFU support added in `v0.0.3`)
Project configuration for the production "mainboard" PCB schematic
Changed: Reimplemented the non-autoincrementing SPI read path and fixed SPI buffer handling
Corrected accelerometer/gyroscope scale
Magnetometer moved to I2C with normalization
STM32CubeMX/STM32CubeIDE toolchain updated to 1.13
RTC wakeup enabled

prose: Spans 2023-06-25 to 2023-07-26. No commits exist between 2023-01-30 (`v0.0.1`)

title: Initial STM32WB55 bring-up

Added: Initial STM32CubeIDE project scaffold for the STM32WB55, with BLE package configured
I2C class, then migrated to a common I2C/SPI interface (settled on SPI for the IMU/magnetometer after early I2C reliability issues)
IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) bring-up with register-bank configuration
Magnetometer enabled over I2C
ADC driver and independent watchdog
Custom class-based logging framework, usable from a Linux terminal
RTC, IPCC, and basic LED/input handling
Changed: STM32Cube sources updated to version 1.11.0

prose: Spans 2022-12-28 to 2023-01-30, the project's first commits.
